statement: ∀ (R h a : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < h → h ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ a → (⌈2*R/h⌉₊ : ℝ)^n * (Real.sqrt n * h)^a ≤ (2*R+1)^n * (Real.sqrt n)^a * h^(a-(n:ℝ))
proof:
intro R h a hR hh hh1 ha
have hm : (⌈2*R/h⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2*R+1)/h := by
  have hc := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ 2*R/h by positivity)
  have hle : 2*R/h + 1 ≤ (2*R+1)/h := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hh).2
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  exact hc.le.trans hle
calc
  (⌈2*R/h⌉₊ : ℝ)^n * (Real.sqrt n * h)^a ≤ ((2*R+1)/h)^n * (Real.sqrt n * h)^a := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hm n) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
  _ = (2*R+1)^n * (Real.sqrt n)^a * h^(a-(n:ℝ)) := by
    rw [div_pow, Real.mul_rpow (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hh.le, Real.rpow_sub hh, Real.rpow_natCast]
    ring
